delivery.outcome: Manually started `opencode serve` processes get a stable proc-N id so they can be targeted by terminal detail/prompt/reply endpoints; set_auto_answer adopts a discovered process into the registry so the supervisor can answer its questions/permissions.
nonGoals: no serve-based drive lane (tillm opencode run stays the drive mechanism)
no changes to supervisor loop or dashboard JS
stop remains refused for unmanaged instances

architecture.decision: proc-N id derived from port in _scan_serve_processes; set_auto_answer falls back to adopting the discovered entry via register_instance(managed=False)

validation.evidence: discovered instances carry proc-N ids; auto_answer adopts them
